text:
Eli: Heads up — I'm planning to bump inference-statefulset (model-x) from 3 -> 5 replicas to improve throughput for inference-p50 spikes. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4121

Chloe: Is this for the online real-time service or batch? Any SLO constraints?

Eli: Online realtime. SLO ~200ms P95. This is to offload tail latency when model hot-shard gets overloaded. Not expecting to change model variant.

Samir: Can replicas alone help? Cold KV cache / model load will still cause spikes. Consider pre-warm init or keep 1 warm replica per AZ.

Mark: From infra side, a couple notes:
- Use StatefulSet RollingUpdate with partition to control ordinals
- Set `maxSurge: 0`, `maxUnavailable: 1` for graceful updates
- PDB should allow 1 pod unavailable (minAvailable: 4 after scale)

Mark: snippet:
```
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 1
podDisruptionBudget:
  minAvailable: 4
```

Chloe: Also add `preStop` to drain connections and increase readiness `initialDelaySeconds` from 5 -> 10. And confirm PVC storageClass won't block new nodes.

Eli: Terraform/helm changes in the PR — showing helm values I updated:
```
replicaCount: 5
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "2000m"
    memory: "12Gi"
  limits:
    cpu: "4000m"
    memory: "24Gi"
podManagementPolicy: Parallel
```

Samir: LGTM but add `preStop` hook and `readinessProbe` tweak. Also ensure daemonset/affinity places at most 2 replicas per GPU rack.

Mark: For affinity, use preferredDuringScheduling with weight 100 for spreadAcrossRack label. Example:
```
topologySpreadConstraints:
- maxSkew: 1
  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/rack
  whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: inference } }
```

Eli: Added preStop hook + readiness changes in latest commit. @samir can you quick-approve? :pray:

Samir: Quick look — small nits but ok for canary. Please run canary traffic to 1 pod and watch p95 for 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary run initiated -> route 10% traffic to pods with label `canary=true` (1/5 pods). Expected warmup: 5m.

Chloe: :thumbsup: I'll monitor traces and cost dashboard.

Samir: LGTM — approve from me.

Eli: Merging now. PR merged: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4121/commits/3a9f2c1

deploy-bot: Helm upgrade completed: inference-statefulset v2.4. Rollout status: 5/5 ready. No errors.

Chloe: great, watching metrics now.

Mark: Nice. Follow-up ticket to revisit autoscaler thresholds and warm-up strategy — I'll create one.
